0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000010_AYMERIC
0.description: Thank you for coming. I wished to speak with you both in a place where privacy was assured.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: We quite understand. What was it that you wished to discuss?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000030_AYMERIC
2.description: With my father's passing, the seat of the archbishop lies vacant. And so, in accordance with canon law, I have assumed his responsibilities.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000040_AYMERIC
3.description: I should stress that this is a temporary measure. It was never intended that the lord commander of the Temple Knights serve in this capacity indefinitely.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000050_AYMERIC
4.description: Quite the opposite. The statutes specify that I should surrender my powers as soon as a conclave of the senior clergy and the High Houses have named a new archbishop.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000060_AYMERIC
5.description: But in light of recent events, that would not seem appropriate.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: I confess, I did not expect you to divulge quite so much quite so soon. The details of the archbishop's plans, perhaps...but the true origin of the war and all it entails...?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000080_AYMERIC
7.description: I too had concerns. But when the Warrior of Light is witnessed returning to the capital upon the back of a dragon, one's options are rather limited.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000090_AYMERIC
8.description: Mayhap I could have concealed certain details...but for how long? And at what risk? Should the truth have come to light in the meantime, how would the people have viewed my silence?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000100_AYMERIC
9.description: After a thousand years of lies and secrecy, I could not well abuse their trust and hope to be believed. The time for deception has passed.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000110_AYMERIC
10.description: ...I only wish the people agreed. That some would deny the truth, I had anticipated─but not <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> many. And among the few who acknowledge that my father had to be stopped, no small number question our methods.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: If they suspect a coup, it will not be long before some turn to violence.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000130_LUCIA
12.description: It has already begun─and that on both sides. Men and women of the cloth are being harassed in the streets. Some have even been assaulted in the Brume.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000140_LUCIA
13.description: Hilda and her people have formed a watch to help us maintain order, but such measures will not prevent the unrest from spreading.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000150_AYMERIC
14.description: For all our talk of peace, the people remain frightened and confused. For their sake, we must bring the Dragonsong War to a definitive end.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000160_ALPHINAUD
15.description: And we should be glad to help you, Ser Aymeric. But what precisely would you have us do?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000170_LUCIA
16.description: We wish to treat with the dragons of Anyx Trine. To that end, I would trouble you for an escort and an introduction.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000180_ALPHINAUD
17.description: Anyx Trine? ...You would speak with <hex:021A020203>Vidofnir<hex:021A020103>, then?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000190_AYMERIC
18.description: We must needs open a dialogue between our peoples. Acting as my representative, Lucia will extend an invitation to their leader, that she might visit us here in Ishgard.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000200_AYMERIC
19.description: Were she still with us, I would of course have beseeched Ysayle's assistance in this matter. But as she is not, I must ask that you aid us in her stead. Will you do us this favor?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000220_AYMERIC
21.description: Lucia─I leave the rest to you.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000230_EDMONT
22.description: In the wake of the archbishop's fall, the nation of Ishgard trembled, the faith of her people shaken to its very core.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000240_EDMONT
23.description: For a thousand years had they fought and died, certain of the justice of their cause,<hex:02100103>only to be told that their holy war was born of the sins of their forefathers.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000250_EDMONT
24.description: What then, for those brave men and women, thus stripped of their righteousness, but to despair?<hex:02100103>To deny the truth and decry its speakers?

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000260_EDMONT
25.description: And what then for those whom they defamed but to hope on? To have faith in a brighter tomorrow?

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000270_EDMONT
26.description: A tomorrow in which man and dragon might live together in harmony─<hex:02100103>then as distant as the very stars in the heavens...

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000280_EDMONT
27.description: Yet while we dared to hope, deep within his lair, the enemy lay gathering his strength.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000290_EDMONT
28.description: Nidhogg, now possessed of his two eyes and the body of the Azure Dragoon─<hex:02100103>prizes to which he had laid claim at the very hour of the heroes' triumph.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000300_EDMONT
29.description: As desperately as we sought the solace of peace, the great wyrm craved the misery of war.<hex:02100103>Nor was he alone in this misbegotten desire...

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000310_KRILE
30.description: I am terribly, terribly sorry to have kept you all waiting!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000320_YSHTOLA
31.description: You need not apologize. We arrived but a moment ago ourselves.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000330_YSHTOLA
32.description: Pray allow me to introduce Krile, who is recently come from the Sharlayan motherland. She has generously offered to assist us.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000340_KRILE
33.description: Oh please, think nothing of it! A trip to Eorzea was long overdue.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000350_KRILE
34.description: You must be the Warrior of Light. Yes...you certainly do look the part. A pleasure to meet you at last, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000360_KRILE
35.description: And who is that I spy but young Alphinaud Leveilleur himself! I daresay someone's grown an ilm or two in my absence─or are those lifts in your boots?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000370_ALPHINAUD
36.description: We, uh... Ahem. Miss Krile and I met at the Studium, years ago. I shall forever be indebted to her for her sage guidance.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000380_KRILE
37.description: It was no small task keeping him out of trouble, believe you me! The youngest ever to enter the Studium─him and his sister, eleven-year-old prodigies.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000390_KRILE
38.description: Suffice it to say, social graces were not among his list of talents! Striding up to his seniors on his first day, head held high─what was it he said again...?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000410_KRILE
40.description: For what? I haven't finished yet. Would you care to attempt a more dextrous deflection?

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000420_ALPHINAUD
41.description: Ahem... Mayhap we should save this delightful conversation for a more fitting occasion, when pressing matters do not demand our undivided attention.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000430_KRILE
42.description: A bit much, but better. I can tell you have been putting your skills to use here in Eorzea. Henceforth, I trust you will dazzle me with your eloquence at the <hex:021A020203>first<hex:021A020103> time of asking.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000440_KRILE
43.description: Right. On to more pressing matters─finding Minfilia and the other missing Scions!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000450_YSHTOLA
44.description: I gather you have new information to share with us?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000460_KRILE
45.description: A new approach, actually. Tataru recounted the tale of your escape, and it gave me an idea.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000470_KRILE
46.description: Simply put, assuming Thancred left some manner of trail when you whisked him away─as is almost always the case with teleportation magicks─I am confident I can find and follow it.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000480_ALPHINAUD
47.description: Then what are you waiting for!?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000490_KRILE
48.description: The wherewithal to do it. The fact is, my abilities aren't quite up to the task. Not in themselves, anyway. If I had Master Matoya's Crystal Eye, on the other hand...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000500_YSHTOLA
49.description: Then let us all call on her forthwith. I think it best that you explain your plan to her in person.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000510_MATOYA
50.description: <sigh> Is that trouble I smell, or did you forget to wipe your boots on the way in?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000520_YSHTOLA
51.description: Forgive us, Master Matoya. We will be sure to wipe them on the way out. And may I say how glad I am that age has not yet deprived you of your senses.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000530_MATOYA
52.description: Ever so quick-witted, aren't we─to the detriment of your manners. Well, out with it then. What do you want?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000540_KRILE
53.description: Pray allow me to introduce myself, Master Matoya. I am Krile, of the Students of Baldesion. I hope you will excuse our unannounced visit.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000550_MATOYA
54.description: Baldesion, you say? Ah yes, the old coot set up shop on the Isle of Val, didn't he?

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000560_KRILE
55.description: Regrettably, our order's headquarters─and the isle itself─were obliterated by a magick of immense power. I have the blessing of Light to thank for my own preservation.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000580_KRILE
57.description: Well yes, of course I do.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000590_KRILE
58.description: Our order is devoted to uncovering the mysteries of Hydaelyn and interpreting Her will, particularly through the study of Her gift to us.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000600_KRILE
59.description: It was in the course of these studies that I met and subsequently befriended Minfilia. She and I have rather a lot in common.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000620_KRILE
61.description: You weren't supposed to. Not that I wanted to deceive you, you understand, but precautions had to be taken.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000630_MATOYA
62.description: Yes, yes─that's all well and good, but you still haven't told me why you're here.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000640_KRILE
63.description: The Students of Baldesion are gone, and there is naught I can do to change that. But the Scions of the Seventh Dawn can yet be restored and my dear friend found.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000650_KRILE
64.description: You have in your possession an ancient Crystal of Light─one you call your “Crystal Eye.” I believe I can use it to focus my abilities and locate one of the missing Scions.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000660_MATOYA
65.description: And there I was thinking you might want to make use of my <hex:021A020203>years of experience<hex:021A020103>... <sigh> Wait here.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000670_YSHTOLA
66.description: Long did I ponder the nature of this crystal and its familiar radiance...but never did I suspect it was a Crystal of Light.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000680_KRILE
67.description: On the cusp of an Umbral Calamity, souls blessed with the power of the Echo invariably appear.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000690_KRILE
68.description: To aid these Her chosen warriors, Hydaelyn bequeaths to each a sliver of Her strength in the form of a Crystal of Light.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000700_KRILE
69.description: But as Her strength wanes, so too does the potency of Her gifts. This crystal, born of an earlier era, is infused with a power far greater than those of this age.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000710_MATOYA
70.description: You could travel the length and breadth of the land and not find a crystal even a fraction as pure. Its value is beyond measure─as are the risks inherent in its use.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000720_KRILE
71.description: No two manifestations of the Echo are alike. I, for example, can converse with beings of every shape and size─excepting beasts, contrary to what others would have you believe. Language has nothing to do with it, of course; rather, I am sensitive to the whispers of the soul. Their intent, their very essence even─the traces of which served to guide the elementals to Y'shtola.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000730_KRILE
72.description: Far-fetched though it may sound, I believe that with your Crystal Eye, I may be able to pick up where they left off and follow the remaining trail to Thancred. That is, if I have your permission...?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000740_MATOYA
73.description: Well, the poor sod's not going to find himself. So, as long as you don't drop it or take it out of my sight, you may do with it what you will.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000770_KRILE
76.description: From the Black Shroud, the trail continues to the north and west...towards a mountain...the foot of Sohm Al.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000780_KRILE
77.description: It was a near thing, but he was not deposited within the rock. I think.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000790_ALPHINAUD
78.description: The hunters of Tailfeather know those lands well. I say we begin our search there!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000800_ALPHINAUD
79.description: Who else could be... Thancred! It could be Thancred! We must hurry!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000850_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
84.description: (-???-)This day we reclaim the reins of history! This day we rid ourselves of the Ascians forever!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000860_ASCIAN
85.description: (-Black-robed Ascian-)<hex:024804F2022303>Fools playing at heroes, all of you. Is this how you believe you can save your world?<hex:0248020103>

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000870_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
86.description: (-???-)We can and will, Ascian! You shall see─or perhaps you will not!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000880_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
87.description: (-???-)So you are the Warrior of Light. The <hex:021A020203>savior<hex:021A020103> of Eorzea.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000890_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
88.description: (-???-)It's a wonder you didn't come sooner, what with the primal and all. Lost a step, have we?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000900_YSHTOLA
89.description: Have care. The aether moves strangely around him.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000910_ALPHINAUD
90.description: It would seem we share a common enemy. Mayhap you would tell us who you are?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000930_ALPHINAUD
92.description: SHORT DEFENDING EXHALATION - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000940_ALPHINAUD
93.description: SHORT DEFENDING EXHALATION - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000950_YSHTOLA
94.description: SHORT DEFENDING EXHALATION - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000960_YSHTOLA
95.description: SHORT DEFENDING EXHALATION - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000970_THANCRED
96.description: SHORT ATTACK GRUNT - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000980_THANCRED
97.description: SHORT ATTACK GRUNT - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_000990_THANCRED
98.description: SHORT ATTACK GRUNT - SHOULD NOT DISPLAY

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001000_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
99.description: (-???-)Not very sporting of you to interrupt, but so be it.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001010_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
100.description: Mark well our faces, Warrior of Light, for we are the Warriors of Darkness. Walkers of a different path. And we shall meet again.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001040_THANCRED
103.description: Pleasantries can wait. I'd rather not be here when the Gnath arrive. Agreed?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001050_YSHTOLA
104.description: Suffice it to say, our reunion was not at all as I pictured it. Waiting until the last instant to join the fray. 'Tis plain you have not lost your appetite for the dramatic.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001060_THANCRED
105.description: <hex:021A020203>My<hex:021A020103> appetite for the dramatic!? Have you forgotten the circumstances of our parting? The heroic last stand, the tunnel filling with light, and then... <sigh>

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001070_THANCRED
106.description: Had I known you intended to use forbidden magicks to deliver me to some godsforsaken wilderness...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001080_THANCRED
107.description: ...I would have thanked you in advance.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001100_THANCRED
109.description: If nothing else, you might have warned me that I would emerge from the Lifestream in the altogether.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001110_THANCRED
110.description: Eventually, I managed to fashion knives from some obsidian I found, and set about hunting for meat and hides.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001120_THANCRED
111.description: Given that I'm not all that skilled in leatherworking, it's probably for the best that I met the Vath before I was reunited with you.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001130_ALPHINAUD
112.description: So <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> were the “fleshling clothed in skins” of whom the storyteller spoke.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001140_THANCRED
113.description: A description which fit me as ill as the skins themselves. Happily, I was able to trade with the Vath for garments better becoming a man of refinement.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001150_THANCRED
114.description: From them I learned of Ravana, and of the great warrior who had once laid him low.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001160_YSHTOLA
115.description: And thence did you conclude that were you to track the primal's movements, it would surely bring you into contact with the Scions once more.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001170_THANCRED
116.description: It seemed a reasonable assumption. I could think of no one else with your enthusiasm for slaying beastman gods. Until now, that is.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001180_ALPHINAUD
117.description: Ah yes...the self-proclaimed “Warriors of Darkness.” 'Tis only fitting that they stand in opposition to the Warrior of Light, I suppose.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001190_KRILE
118.description: I glimpsed the leader's past─if only for a moment. They were confronting a man in black. An Ascian, I think.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001200_ALPHINAUD
119.description: If these warriors are capable of doing battle with Ascians and primals both, they must be possessed of powerful protection─protection not unlike the Echo...

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001210_EDMONT
120.description: Even as the Scions celebrated the return of a long-lost friend, honorable men plotted to deprive them of another.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001220_EDMONT
121.description: Honorable men, to whom Ser Aymeric was no hero but a scheming patricide.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001230_EDMONT
122.description: Honorable men, who would fain wash the paving stones of Foundation with the tyrant's blood.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001240_EDMONT
123.description: Honorable men, whose knife in the dark was the spark which set the city aflame. And who sang as it burned.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001250_LUCIA
124.description: I do not mean to diminish our accomplishments, but until we identify the ones who ordered the fires set, our work is far from finished.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001260_THANCRED
125.description: Between the various conservative and religious factions in Ishgard, I daresay there is no shortage of parties who would like to see the status quo preserved. Do any likely suspects spring to mind?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001300_AYMERIC
129.description: Time is of the essence. Lest we forget, these men would sooner put their own city to the torch than see it change.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001310_AYMERIC
130.description: When our enemies learn that we have apprehended their arsonist, there is no telling how they will react.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001320_TEMPLERKNIGHT10810
131.description: Lord Commander! An armed mob has seized control of the Vault!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001330_AYMERIC
132.description: And now we know. Tell us what happened, ser. Spare no detail.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001340_TEMPLERKNIGHT10810
133.description: We were directing refugees into the basilica, as you ordered, when all of a sudden, men brandishing weapons were all around us. It happened so fast, my lord. We had no time to respond.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001350_TEMPLERKNIGHT10810
134.description: They've taken the refugees hostage and barricaded themselves inside the Vault.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001360_AYMERIC
135.description: And they sent you to deliver their demands.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001370_TEMPLERKNIGHT10810
136.description: They...the True Brothers of the Faith demand that a conclave to select the next archbishop be held forthwith. Furthermore, th-they declare that you, Lord Commander, are guilty of patricide and high treason, and that you must surrender yourself at once to receive of the Fury's judgment.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001380_LUCIA
137.description: Ridiculous! Do they honestly think that executing Ser Aymeric will change anything? That the truth will somehow die with him?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001390_ARTOIREL
138.description: These fundamentalists rage against the passing of the old ways, unable to accept there can be no going back.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001400_EDMONT
139.description: Given the fanciful nature of their demands, a peaceful resolution does not seem likely. If the hostages are to be rescued, it will be by force, I fear.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001410_AYMERIC
140.description: Agreed. Lucia, take a contingent of knights and establish a perimeter outside the entrance.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001430_AYMERIC
142.description: Hilda, I need your people out in force throughout the Brume. When word spreads of the situation, the friends and family of the hostages may try to take matters into their own hands. I will not give these militants more targets.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001440_AYMERIC
143.description: I shall lead the assault on the Vault. Master Alphinaud, can I count on the support of the Scions?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001470_ARTOIREL
146.description: I shall join you as well, Lord Commander!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001480_AYMERIC
147.description: Your assistance is most welcome, Lord Artoirel. To arms then, friends! Time is against us!

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001490_AYMERIC
148.description: Where is he? Where is he!?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001510_AYMERIC
150.description: You have nowhere to run! Release the girl and surrender!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001520_ISHGARDIANPRIEST
151.description: Surrender to whom!? The blasphemer who throws wide the gates to our enemy, who breaks bread with him and calls him brother!? Ungodly swine! I would sooner <hex:021A020203>die<hex:021A020103> than surrender to you!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001530_AYMERIC
152.description: Is it <hex:021A020203>godly<hex:021A020103> to spill the blood of an innocent child!? To burn the homes of your brothers!? Tell me, priest─<hex:021A020203>is that godly<hex:021A020103>!?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001540_ISHGARDIANPRIEST
153.description: Do not speak to me of godliness, heathen! Your father's blood is on your hands─as is hers!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001580_VIDOFNIR
157.description: Well met, knight. Mayhap I chose an inopportune moment?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001590_LUCIA
158.description: Not at all! Pray forgive us this most unworthy reception. We are honored to have you with us, and right glad of your aid!

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001600_VIDOFNIR
159.description: Fortune delivered the child unto me. I had but to receive her.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001630_AYMERIC
162.description: Never did I think to be indebted to so unexpected a savior. But full glad am I to be so.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001640_VIDOFNIR
163.description: Friend of Ysayle, warrior of warriors, I had hoped to meet with thee.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001650_VIDOFNIR
164.description: I bear a message from my sire.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001670_VIDOFNIR
166.description: Upon returning to our lands, Nidhogg's shade did sing unto his brood, and they for skies unknown did then take wing.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001680_VIDOFNIR
167.description: This thou must know, for your fates are inextricably bound.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001690_ALPHINAUD
168.description: What of Estinien? Is he truly lost to us?

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001700_VIDOFNIR
169.description: Such matters are beyond my ken. I but bear my father's words. Take from them what thou wilt.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001720_EDMONT
171.description: So it is as they say, then. A great white dragon swooped down from the heavens to rescue an innocent child.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001730_AYMERIC
172.description: A most unexpected turn of events...but not an unwelcome one. The people will not soon forget this day.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001740_EDMONT
173.description: Yet how will they choose to remember it, Ser Aymeric? And will these events serve to bring man and dragon closer together, or drive a deeper wedge between brothers?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001750_EDMONT
174.description: After a thousand years, the world these men once knew is changing─and with ungentle swiftness to boot. Though their actions are misguided, their sentiments are only to be expected. You may be sure that others will rally to their cause.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001760_EDMONT
175.description: I share your desire for a lasting peace with the Dravanians, I do, but I would not see it built on the bones of our countrymen─nor on our own.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001770_EDMONT
176.description: I see much of Haurchefant in you. And I could not bear to mourn the passing of another son.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001790_ALPHINAUD
178.description: That Vidofnir should chance to arrive even as the girl fell... Truly, I could not have planned it better myself.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001800_ARTOIREL
179.description: Ah, good. We were afraid you might have left.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001820_ARTOIREL
181.description: Fit for a true knight. An expression of our gratitude to you and yours, long overdue.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001830_ARTOIREL
182.description: ...But there is something else I would discuss ere you part. Something which cannot leave this room. My father will soon step down as head of our house.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001840_ARTOIREL
183.description: Ser Aymeric was not the only one to fall under suspicion following the death of the archbishop. There are some who believe my father complicit in a coup d'état.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001850_ARTOIREL
184.description: Thus he intends to renounce his title to absolve our house of suspicion and secure the support of our peers.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001860_ALPHINAUD
185.description: Surely there must be another way to convince houses Durendaire and Dzemael?

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001870_ARTOIREL
186.description: So I said to him. Alas, he will not budge.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001880_ARTOIREL
187.description: Ever since I was a child, I knew that I would one day succeed my father, and the thought of it filled me with pride. Yet once I learned the day was at hand, my heart was filled with naught but dread.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001890_ARTOIREL
188.description: Our legacy is built upon the lies of our forefathers. In accepting this title, am I not perpetuating this injustice? Why should I become the next count?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001900_ARTOIREL
192.description: You sound just like him. Aye, I suspect that is what Haurchefant would have said. “To aid those in need...”

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001910_ARTOIREL
193.description: ...But then I thought of my brother. “A knight lives to serve─to aid those in need.”

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001920_ARTOIREL
194.description: When you look on that shield, I trust you will remember his words. And should I once more find my resolve wavering, I ask that you show me the way.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001930_ARTOIREL
195.description: You were a <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203> to Haurchefant. Will you be a <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203> to me as well?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001940_ARTOIREL
196.description: Come, Emmanellain. There is much to be done. For Father, and for Ser Aymeric. And for Ishgard.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001950_ARTOIREL
197.description: <sigh> To think we share the same blood... Pray excuse us.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001960_EDMONT
198.description: Those were the days of promises and vows─of tentative first steps into an uncertain future.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001970_EDMONT
199.description: A future shaped by the choices we made, in ways we could never have foreseen.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001980_EDMONT
200.description: Born of good and evil, of light and darkness, and shepherded by our hand.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_001990_EDMONT
201.description: Be it for weal, or be it for woe.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03100_002000_NARRATION
202.description: From the memoirs of Count Edmont de Fortemps<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Heavensward: As Goes Light, So Goes Darkness<hex:021A020103>
